dimensions.summary:
Local SEO, E-E-A-T and CRO audit of the HEAD a7aaedfc build (7,050 HTML pages), cross-checked against the live site with 2 TinyFish calls (blog pages, main site, Google Maps listing, sameAs profiles). The repo was not changed. Scripts and outputs are in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-blog/c0138ac4-51ee-5beb-a1c9-21d2311d0295/scratchpad/audit/local-eeat-cro/ (nap_scan.py/.json, cta_types.py, forbidden.py, mobile.js/.json plus screenshots, assistant_test.js/.json).

What is fine (FACT):
- NAP is fully consistent. There is exactly one tel/Zalo/WhatsApp/Maps/mailto target across 7,050 pages, and hours are 09:00–21:00 everywhere.
- No 24/7 claim and no forbidden claim appears in template-level text.
- The JSON-LD NAP matches _data/business.yml.
- The live Google Maps listing (38 reviews, open 9AM–9PM daily) and the main site carry the same address, hours and prices.
- /bang-gia/ and the per-vehicle pricing tables render exactly from _data/pricing.yml, including deposits.
- Floating CTAs cover only 2.6% of the mobile viewport and never auto-open, so they comply with the interstitial guidance.
- Privacy and terms pages are linked on 7,047 pages.

Main gaps (new, not covered by SEO-001..121):
- (P1) The site never says who writes the content or how. 6,257 AI-factory posts, published over 49 days (2,247 dated 2026-10-15), are all bylined "Nguyễn Tú", and nothing on the site discloses the AI drafting or the QA process. On top of that, 83 posts invent first-person anecdotes such as "khách hỏi tôi" ("customers ask me").
- (P1) There is no analytics or conversion tracking on any of the 7,050 pages (no GA4, GTM or other tag), so about 125k contact links are unmeasured.
- The 50cc price shown on the About page, in the FAQ and meta description of the 50cc page, in the site-wide chat assistant and in docs/LOCAL-SEO.md is stale compared with pricing.yml (200.000đ/ngày, deposit 4.000.000đ). The assistant answers every 50cc question with the electric-bicycle answer.
- The post byline is not linked, and the BlogPosting author has no url.
- The sameAs and footer profiles are hard-coded. The live about.me profile claims "hơn 10 năm kinh nghiệm" (10+ years' experience), "hàng đầu" (leading) and "tốt nhất" (best), which are claims the site's own rules forbid.
- 254 posts were corrected in place but show no update date.
- Opening hours are hard-coded in three places outside business.yml.

Google Business Profile management is UNKNOWN (no access). Per AGENTS.md, rental policies stated on static pages without verification in data/business-facts.json are listed last, as NEEDS_OWNER. They include helmet included, no insurance provided, age 18+, minimum rental 1 day, and the 24-hour day cycle, which contradicts the main site's live text.

findings.title: No Who/How/Why transparency: 6,257 AI-factory posts bylined 'Nguyễn Tú' with no disclosure of authorship or editorial/QA process anywhere on the site
findings.evidence: FACT: `ls _posts` = 6,257 posts dated 2026-09-13..2026-10-31 (49 days), 2,247 of them dated 2026-10-15. 5,155 posts carry factory front matter `writer: W1..W6` (writer_session e.g. s-claude-w3 = 1,877, s-mistral-w1 = 346). The session labels are not rendered: 0 built HTML files contain them. All 6,257 posts have `author: "Nguyễn Tú"`. A grep for AI|trí tuệ nhân tạo|biên tập|kiểm duyệt|đính chính|chính sách nội dung over gioi-thieu.md, lien-he.md, bao-mat.md, dieu-khoan.md, index.md, _layouts/*.html and _includes/footer.html finds 0 statements about how content is produced or reviewed. The live /gioi-thieu/ page (TinyFish 2026-10-31) covers only the rental business. The owner's main site already labels its images 'Ảnh AI minh họa' (live), so there is precedent for disclosure. Google (creating-helpful-content, 2026-10-05) asks: 'Is the use of automation, including AI-generation, self-evident to visitors through disclosures…?', 'Do bylines lead to further information about the author…?', and lists 'using generative AI to produce large amounts of text without manual oversight' as low effort. The gen-AI guidance says generating many pages without added value may violate the scaled content abuse policy.
findings.root_cause: The site grew from a business brochure into a high-volume AI-assisted content factory (AGENTS.md, docs/CONTENT-FACTORY.md), but the public About page was never updated to explain how content is produced. INFERRED: volume + uniform brand byline + no disclosure raise trust/quality-system risk.
findings.proposed_fix: Owner-approved wording; the implementation is a SAFE_PAGE_CONTENT edit to gioi-thieu.md (outside _posts). Add a section `## Về nội dung trên blog {#ve-noi-dung}` stating only facts that exist in the repo: (1) articles are drafted with AI tools; (2) every article passes automated checks before publishing (quality score ≥ 75, SEO ≥ 70, prices/deposits/hours checked against the owner-approved data that /bang-gia/ shows, legal statements must cite an official source); (3) older articles show a 'Giá thuê tham khảo hiện hành' box or a legal-correction notice until the text is fixed; (4) readers can report errors by email or Zalo (links from _data/business.yml). Mention a human review only if the owner confirms who reviews and how often. Do NOT invent credentials, years of experience or awards. Optionally add a 'Cách chúng tôi viết bài' link to the footer PHÁP LÝ group in _data/navigation.yml. Owner decision, separate from the template work: production pacing and spot human review, given the scaled-content policy. Quality gates must not change.
findings.rollback: git revert of the gioi-thieu.md and navigation.yml commit; no URL, post or schema changes.
findings.benefit: Aligns the site with Google's Who/How/Why guidance and reduces deception risk around authorship. It also gives readers a reason to trust price and legal information, at no cost to URLs or post bytes.
findings.next: Chờ chủ website quyết định (xem báo cáo wave4)

findings.title: No analytics or conversion measurement on any page: about 125k contact CTAs (tel/Zalo/WhatsApp/Maps) are unmeasured
findings.evidence: FACT: nap_scan.py over 7,050 built HTML files found 0 pages with googletagmanager/gtag(/google-analytics/GTM-/G-/fbq/clarity/plausible/umami. _layouts/default.html contains only the google-site-verification meta. Unmeasured conversion links: 34,532 tel:+84942467674, 34,524 Zalo, 28,195 WhatsApp, 28,190 Maps. .post-cta appears on 6,319 pages and the floating launcher on 7,047. The live main site has meta generator 'Site Kit by Google 1.190.0', so the owner already uses Google tooling there. Search Console data for the blog is not connected (SEO-109 OPEN). Per the research file, the blog ranks in the top 10 for only 1 of 9 tracked commercial queries.
findings.root_cause: The templates were never given a measurement ID. The owner's GA4/GTM ID is not in the repo (UNKNOWN) and must not be invented.
findings.proposed_fix: Owner supplies a GA4 measurement ID (a new data stream or property). Then, as a SAFE_TEMPLATE change: add `ga4_measurement_id: ""` to _config.yml (empty means off). Create `_includes/analytics.html`, which loads gtag.js only when the ID is set, and include it in the head of `_layouts/default.html`. Add a single delegated click listener that sends `contact_click` with method=tel|zalo|whatsapp|maps|email (from the href prefix) and cta_location=post-cta|phone-launcher|footer|page (from the closest container class); mark it as a key event in GA4. Update bao-mat.md 'Thông tin chúng tôi thu thập' to disclose analytics cookies and the localStorage theme key 'nguyentu-theme', and confirm with the owner what consent current Vietnamese personal-data rules require. Also connect the blog property to Search Console tooling (SEO-109).
findings.rollback: Set ga4_measurement_id back to empty (the tag stops rendering); revert the include and bao-mat.md.
findings.benefit: Makes every CRO and SEO change in this audit measurable (CTA clicks by page type and template). It is the prerequisite for LCRO-10 and for any decision on hub CTAs or content pacing.
findings.next: Chờ chủ website quyết định (xem báo cáo wave4)

findings.title: Stale 50cc price statements contradict _data/pricing.yml on the About page, the 50cc page FAQ and meta description, and writer docs
findings.evidence: FACT: _data/pricing.yml (approved 27/10/2026) has xe-tay-ga-50cc day 200000, week/month quote 'Báo giá riêng', deposit 4000000. data/business-facts.json and the live main site table show the same. Contradictions: gioi-thieu.md:43 'Với xe 50cc, xe máy điện và xe đạp điện, vui lòng liên hệ trực tiếp để biết giá hiện tại' (live-verified), and the gioi-thieu.md:39 bullet and the reference price list have no 50cc price. bang-gia-xe-50cc.md:4 description is 'Liên hệ Nguyễn Tú để biết giá thuê xe 50cc hiện tại' (live meta). In bang-gia-xe-50cc.md:118-120 the FAQ 'Giá thuê xe 50cc là bao nhiêu?' answers 'Giá thay đổi… Vui lòng liên hệ…' while the table on the same page shows 200.000 VND (live). docs/LOCAL-SEO.md:15-16 still lists superseded prices (Vision 800k–1tr/tuần; Air Blade 800k/tuần and 1,4tr/tháng; Click/Mio 600–700k/tuần and 1–1,2tr/tháng; 50cc 'liên hệ') and 'Đặt cọc: không nêu con số'. reports/factory/business-fact-conflicts.md is equally stale. The query 'thuê xe máy 50cc hà nội' has volume 110/mo with a local pack (research file). This is new: SEO-110 synced weekly/monthly prices, but the 50cc daily price and deposit were approved later.
findings.root_cause: The 27/10 pricing approval added a 50cc daily rate and per-model deposits, but prose on pages outside the pricing include, and the writer docs, still carry the earlier 'contact for price' wording.
findings.proposed_fix: SAFE_PAGE_CONTENT, with values copied only from _data/pricing.yml. (1) gioi-thieu.md:43 → 'Với xe tay ga 50cc, giá thuê tham khảo 200.000đ/ngày; giá tuần và tháng báo giá riêng. Với xe máy điện và xe đạp điện, vui lòng liên hệ trực tiếp để biết giá hiện tại, vì mức giá phụ thuộc vào mẫu xe và tình trạng xe sẵn có.' Also add '- Xe tay ga 50cc: 200.000đ/ngày; giá tuần, tháng báo giá riêng' to the 'Vài mức giá tham khảo' list. (2) bang-gia-xe-50cc.md:4 description → 'Thuê xe tay ga 50cc tại Hà Nội: giá tham khảo 200.000đ/ngày, cọc 4.000.000đ, giá tuần/tháng báo riêng; đặc điểm, giấy tờ và cách đặt xe.' (3) bang-gia-xe-50cc.md:120 FAQ answer → 'Giá tham khảo của xe tay ga 50cc là 200.000đ/ngày; giá theo tuần và theo tháng được báo riêng. Tiền đặt cọc tham khảo 4.000.000đ là khoản riêng, không tính vào giá thuê. Giá và tình trạng xe cần được xác nhận trước khi đặt.' (4) docs/LOCAL-SEO.md:15-16: replace the restated numbers with a pointer ('Giá và tiền cọc: chỉ đọc từ _data/pricing.yml / data/business-facts.json; không chép số vào tài liệu này'). Verify with node scripts/tests/test-pricing-data.cjs, scripts/seo/check-regressions.py and a grep for '50cc' near 'liên hệ'. The homepage (frozen) is not touched.
findings.rollback: git revert of the edits to the three .md files (no _posts, URL or schema changes).
findings.benefit: Removes contradictory price signals on a commercial page (and its SERP snippet) and on the About page. It also stops writers re-introducing superseded prices.
findings.verdict: CHƯA PHẢN BIỆN — agent phản biện lỗi do giới hạn sử dụng 5 giờ của tài khoản (31/10/2026 ~19:10 UTC)

findings.title: Site-wide 'Hỏi nhanh' assistant gives the wrong answer for 50cc, falls back to 'no information' for deposit and delivery, and its contact answers have no tappable links
findings.evidence: FACT: Playwright ran NguyenTuAssistant.processQuestion on the built /bang-gia/ (assistant_test.json). 'xe 50cc', 'giá thuê xe 50cc' and 'thuê xe 50cc bao nhiêu' all return 'Xe đạp điện nhẹ nhàng… Vui lòng liên hệ để biết giá.', because assets/js/assistant.js:149 maps 'xe 50cc' to 'electric-scooter'. 'cọc bao nhiêu', 'tiền đặt cọc', 'giao xe' and 'xe máy điện giá' return the fallback 'Mình chưa có thông tin chắc chắn…' even though data/business-facts.json has deposit_policy.statement/refund and delivery.statement. The contact answers ('Bạn có thể liên hệ Nguyễn Tú qua Zalo.', 'Số điện thoại: 0942 467 674') are rendered with textContent, so there is no link. _data/assistant.yml has no 50cc entry and hard-codes prices instead of reading pricing.yml. The assistant ships on 7,047 pages and is the only persistent contact element on desktop: at 1366px Playwright saw no phone launcher and 0 tel links in the first viewport of posts and pricing pages.
findings.root_cause: The rule-based assistant's keyword map and its YAML entries predate the 27/10 pricing and deposit approval and were never extended.
findings.proposed_fix: SAFE_TEMPLATE, with answer text copied verbatim from data/business-facts.json / _data/pricing.yml. (1) _data/assistant.yml: add `id: xe-50cc` with answer 'Xe tay ga 50cc: giá tham khảo 200.000đ/ngày; giá tuần và tháng báo giá riêng; tiền đặt cọc tham khảo 4.000.000đ (khoản riêng, không tính vào giá thuê). Giá và tình trạng xe cần xác nhận trước khi đặt.'; add `id: deposit` (deposit_policy.statement + ' ' + deposit_policy.refund); add `id: delivery` (delivery.statement). (2) assets/js/assistant.js keyword map: put '50cc' and 'xe 50cc' → 'xe-50cc' before 'xe ga'; 'coc' and 'dat coc' → 'deposit'; 'giao xe' and 'giao nhan' → 'delivery'; 'xe may dien' → 'electric-bike'. (3) In addMessage, for answers to phone/zalo/whatsapp/maps, append an <a> built with createElement from window.NGUYEN_TU_BUSINESS.contact (phone_uri/zalo/whatsapp/maps). Keep textContent for the message text and never use innerHTML. Re-run the Playwright test, expecting non-fallback answers, plus node scripts/tests/test-pricing-data.cjs.
findings.rollback: git revert of _data/assistant.yml and assets/js/assistant.js.
findings.benefit: Removes a site-wide wrong price answer, answers the two most common pre-booking questions (deposit, delivery) from approved data, and turns assistant answers into one-tap contact.
findings.verdict: CHƯA PHẢN BIỆN — agent phản biện lỗi do giới hạn sử dụng 5 giờ của tài khoản (31/10/2026 ~19:10 UTC)

findings.title: Author byline is plain text with no author page, and BlogPosting author has no url (6,257 posts)
findings.evidence: FACT: _layouts/post.html renders `… {{ page.author }}` with no link (Playwright: authorLink=false on the newest post). _includes/seo.html emits BlogPosting `"author": {"@type": "Person", "name": "Nguyễn Tú"}` with no url or sameAs; the built JSON-LD on 6,257 posts matches. No author or bio page exists, and /gioi-thieu/ has no section about the author. Google's Article structured data doc: 'we strongly recommend using the type and url (or sameAs) properties'; author.url is 'a link to a web page that uniquely identifies the author… an "about me" page'.
findings.root_cause: The byline was added as a display string in the original theme. Author markup best practices were never applied.
findings.proposed_fix: SAFE_TEMPLATE. post.html: `{% include icon.html name="pen" %} {{ page.author }}`; until LCRO-01's section exists, link to '/gioi-thieu/'. seo.html BlogPosting author: add `"url": {{ '/gioi-thieu/' | absolute_url | jsonify }}`. Owner decision (optional): if 'Nguyễn Tú' denotes the brand rather than an individual writer, use `"author": {"@type": "Organization", "@id": "/#organization", "name": …, "url": …}`. Do not create a fabricated person bio. Verify by rebuilding and parsing all BlogPosting nodes: author.url should be present on 6,257 posts, and faq_parity_check.py (JSON-LD parse) and check-regressions.py should pass. No post bytes change.
findings.rollback: git revert of _layouts/post.html and _includes/seo.html.
findings.benefit: Bylines lead to information about who is behind the content, as the Who/How/Why guidance recommends, and Google gets an unambiguous author entity.
findings.verdict: CHƯA PHẢN BIỆN — agent phản biện lỗi do giới hạn sử dụng 5 giờ của tài khoản (31/10/2026 ~19:10 UTC)

findings.title: AI-written posts present first-person experiences ('khách hay hỏi tôi…') under the owner's byline, and no writer rule governs this
findings.evidence: FACT: a regex over _posts bodies found 83 posts with '(hỏi|nhắn|kể với|gọi cho) tôi' (76 of them from writer W2), 255 with 'tôi (thường|hay|vẫn|từng|gặp)', and 1,066 using 'tôi' at all. Samples: BLG-01498 'khách thuê xe hay hỏi tôi chạy xe máy Mai Châu mang gì'; BLG-03495 'Khách thuê xe ở trọ quanh Đống Đa hay hỏi tôi'; BLG-03392; BLG-04664. A grep of docs/ARTICLE-RULES.md, QUALITY-RUBRIC.md, AI-WRITER-QUICKSTART.md and TURBO-WRITER-RUNBOOK.md for voice/first-person/experience rules found 0. INFERRED: unless the owner supplied these anecdotes, they read as fabricated first-hand experience. Google says to 'avoid using deceptive authorship information… to make content appear as if it was written by human experts'.
findings.root_cause: Writer prompts allow a persona voice, and the QA scorer checks numbers and sources but not experiential claims.
findings.proposed_fix: (a) Owner approves a new rule in docs/ARTICLE-RULES.md and AI-WRITER-QUICKSTART.md: 'Không viết trải nghiệm ngôi thứ nhất (khách hỏi tôi, tôi thường…) trừ khi chủ xe cung cấp tình huống thật; dùng giọng trung tính (ví dụ "nhiều khách thuê thường hỏi")'. Quality gates are not lowered. (b) The owner reviews the 83-post list (reproducible with the regex above). Any anecdote that is not genuine is reworded only through scripts/factory/revise-published.py with --approval-ref, in batches of ≤ 50. No direct _posts edits.
findings.rollback: Revert the docs rule; revise-published.py has its own rollback per batch backup.
findings.benefit: Removes a deception signal from future posts and gives a controlled path to clean existing ones, which supports E-E-A-T trust.
findings.next: Chờ chủ website quyết định (xem báo cáo wave4)

findings.title: sameAs and footer profiles are hard-coded outside the business data source, and the live about.me/Pinterest profiles contradict the site's forbidden_claims and service areas
findings.evidence: FACT: _includes/seo.html hard-codes 4 sameAs URLs (Facebook, TripAdvisor, about.me, Pinterest). _data/navigation.yml ('HỒ SƠ & MẠNG XÃ HỘI') repeats them. Neither _data/business.yml nor data/business-facts.json lists them. They appear in JSON-LD on 7,050 pages and in the footer on 7,047. Live check (TinyFish 2026-10-31): about.me/thuexemaynguyentu says 'Với hơn 10 năm kinh nghiệm', 'lựa chọn hàng đầu', 'dịch vụ cho thuê xe máy tốt nhất tại Hà Nội' and 'cam kết', has the headline 'Student and Web Developer in long bien hanoi', and lists Đống Đa, Cầu Giấy, Hà Đông, Hoàng Mai and Thanh Xuân as service areas, none of which are in the business.yml areas. The Pinterest profile has 0 followers and the same district list. TripAdvisor returned 403 and Facebook a login wall (UNKNOWN). data/business-facts.json forbidden_claims include 'số năm kinh nghiệm', 'xếp hạng, top' and 'cam kết'.
findings.root_cause: The profile URLs were added straight into the templates, with no verification or ownership check, and the off-site bios were written before the site's forbidden_claims rules existed.
findings.proposed_fix: Owner action first: update the about.me and Pinterest bios to verified facts only (NAP, 09:00–21:00, areas from _data/business.yml; no years, top or cam kết claims), or drop those profiles. Then, as a SAFE_TEMPLATE change, add an owner-verified `profiles:` list to _data/business.yml, render `sameAs` in _includes/seo.html and the footer 'HỒ SƠ & MẠNG XÃ HỘI' links from it, and remove the hard-coded copies. Keep only profiles the owner controls and has checked. Adding the main site to sameAs is the owner's call (the research notes say it is treated as a separate property).
findings.rollback: Revert seo.html, navigation.yml and business.yml (the profiles key).
findings.benefit: Profiles that Google may connect to the business no longer contradict on-site facts, and the profile list has one source of truth.
findings.next: Chờ chủ website quyết định (xem báo cáo wave4)

findings.title: 254 posts were corrected in place (price/legal/deposit) but show no 'updated' date, and dateModified equals datePublished
findings.evidence: FACT: reports/qa-audit/revise/*.json contains 11 batches (2026-10-23..27) covering 254 distinct BLG IDs edited through revise-published.py. Example: BLG-01632 (/thue-xe/2026/10/07/khach-quoc-te-tra-xe-ngoai-gio-nen-bo-tri-ra-sao/) was revised 2026-10-23, yet its built JSON-LD has datePublished = dateModified = 2026-10-07T02:00:00+00:00 and the live page shows no 'Cập nhật' date. Only 4 posts set last_modified_at. _layouts/post.html shows only page.date.
findings.root_cause: revise-published.py changes body text only (by design, to keep permalinks and front matter stable), so the templates never learn that a revision happened.
findings.proposed_fix: SAFE_TEMPLATE with a data file (non-business). Add a read-only scripts/seo/build-revision-dates.py that maps article_id → permalink from _posts front matter (read-only) and writes `_data/content-revisions.json` = {permalink: latest created_at} from the revise backups. In post.html, after the date: `{% assign rev = site.data.content-revisions[page.url] %}{% if rev %}Cập nhật {{ rev | date: "%d/%m/%Y" }}{% endif %}`. In seo.html: `"dateModified": "{{ rev | default: page.last_modified_at | default: page.date | date_to_xmlschema }}"`. Only substantive revisions (price, legal, deposit) qualify. No _posts bytes change. Verify that the 254 URLs have dateModified > datePublished and that faq_parity_check and check-regressions pass.
findings.rollback: Delete _data/content-revisions.json (the templates fall back to page.date) or revert the two templates.
findings.benefit: Gives readers and Google a truthful freshness and correction signal on posts whose prices or legal facts were fixed.
findings.verdict: Không qua phản biện (P3 — workflow chỉ phản biện P0–P2)

findings.title: Opening hours are hard-coded in 3 places outside _data/business.yml, and the static status badge always says 'Đang mở' before JavaScript runs
findings.evidence: FACT: _data/business.yml has hours '09:00 - 21:00', but _includes/seo.html hard-codes "opens": "09:00" and "closes": "21:00". assets/js/main.js:74-76 hard-codes OPEN_HOUR 9 / CLOSE_HOUR 21 and the string 'Mở cửa lúc 09:00'. The header, mobile-menu and footer badges ship the static text 'Đang mở' / 'Đang mở cửa' (3 per page × 7,047 pages), which shows before JS and to non-JS agents at any hour. The JS logic itself is correct: it uses the Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh timezone, and Playwright at Hanoi night time showed 'Đã đóng'. The live Google Maps listing currently shows 9AM–9PM daily, which matches.
findings.root_cause: The status widget and JSON-LD were written with literal hours instead of reading the business data file.
findings.proposed_fix: SAFE_TEMPLATE, with no business-data edit. In seo.html: `{% assign ld_hours = business.hours | split: ' - ' %}`, then use ld_hours[0] / ld_hours[1] for opens/closes. In header.html and footer.html, give each badge `data-open="{{ ld_hours[0] }}" data-close="{{ ld_hours[1] }}"` and the neutral default text 'Giờ mở cửa {{ business.hours }}'. In main.js, read the hours from the data attributes (fallback 9/21) and build the 'Mở cửa lúc …' string from them. Verify with check-regressions.py and Playwright runs with timezoneId Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh at 08:00, 10:00 and 22:00.
findings.rollback: git revert of seo.html, header.html, footer.html and main.js.
findings.benefit: A future change to the hours in business.yml then propagates everywhere (UI, status, JSON-LD), with no drift from the Google Business Profile hours, and static HTML never claims the shop is open when it is closed.
findings.verdict: Không qua phản biện (P3 — workflow chỉ phản biện P0–P2)
findings.next: Đợt 5 (sau khi đợt 4 live và có kết quả phản biện)

findings.title: CRO: floating CTAs comply with interstitial guidance (keep), but the post CTA lacks WhatsApp, desktop has no early contact, and verified Google reviews are not referenced
findings.evidence: FACT (Playwright, mobile 390×844): the only fixed elements are the phone launcher (56×56) and 'Hỏi nhanh' (122×44), covering 2.6% of the viewport, plus a 3px progress bar. The assistant opens only on click, which complies with the intrusive-interstitial guidance; no change needed there. Desktop at 1366px: 0 tel links in the first viewport of posts, /bang-gia/ and hubs. The inline .post-cta starts at 75–84% of page height (post 81% on mobile, /thue-xe/thue-thang/ 84%). _includes/post-cta.html offers Gọi, Zalo and Xem bảng giá, but no WhatsApp, even though WhatsApp is used in 28,195 links elsewhere. The site's Maps link resolves (live) to the Google Business Profile 'Thuê xe máy ở Hà Nội - Nguyễn Tú' with 38 Google reviews, but /lien-he/ and /gioi-thieu/ do not point readers to these third-party reviews. INFERRED: the impact cannot be quantified until LCRO-02 is in place.
findings.root_cause: The CTA set was designed for mobile (the launcher is hidden on desktop) and Vietnamese callers. Review proof was deliberately kept off-site, which is correct for markup but leaves no link either.
findings.proposed_fix: Ship after LCRO-02 so the effect can be measured. In _includes/post-cta.html, add `WhatsApp`. In lien-he.md, under the Địa chỉ card, add '[Xem đánh giá của khách trên Google Maps]({{ business.contact.maps }})': no rating number in the text and no Review/AggregateRating markup, because self-serving reviews are not eligible. For commercial hubs (hub.html/topic.html under /thue-xe/), optionally add a compact contact row after the intro. No pop-ups and no auto-opening of the assistant.
findings.rollback: git revert of post-cta.html, lien-he.md and hub.html.
findings.benefit: Lowers the contact barrier for foreign visitors and desktop readers, and adds genuine third-party social proof without breaking structured-data rules.
findings.verdict: Không qua phản biện (P3 — workflow chỉ phản biện P0–P2)
findings.next: Đợt 5 (sau khi đợt 4 live và có kết quả phản biện)

findings.title: NAP is consistent across the site, the Google Business Profile and the main site (keep). Minor variants: name string, admin-unit wording, 1 post with wrong hours, and a stale NAP policy doc
findings.evidence: FACT (nap_scan.py, 7,050 pages): exactly one tel target (tel:+84942467674, 34,532 links), one Zalo (zalo.me/0942467674), one WhatsApp (wa.me/84942467674), one Maps short link and one mailto. The visible phone is formatted '0942 467 674' (15,106). Hour strings are only 09:00–21:00 variants. 0 '24/7' claims in templates, pages or posts. JSON-LD: telephone +84942467674, 112 Nguyễn Văn Cừ / Long Biên / Hà Nội, opens/closes 09:00/21:00. Live: the Maps link resolves to the Google Business Profile (9AM–9PM daily, owner description with the identical address), and the main site has the same NAP and price table. Variants: the Google listing's name is 'Thuê xe máy ở Hà Nội - Nguyễn Tú' vs display_name 'Thuê Xe Máy Hà Nội Nguyễn Tú'; gioi-thieu.md prose says 'phường Bồ Đề, quận Long Biên' (pre-2025 admin-unit wording); BLG-01632 says 'cửa hàng cho thuê mở cửa lúc tám' and describes pre-dawn pickups, conflicting with 09:00 and 'không giao xe ngoài giờ' (the only outlier found among 6,257 posts); docs/NAP-CONTACT-POLICY.md says the footer must NOT carry the full address, phone, Zalo, WhatsApp, Maps or a global LocalBusiness, which contradicts the implemented (consistent) footer and the SEO-106 DECIDED_KEEP. Google Business Profile management itself is UNKNOWN (no access).
findings.root_cause: The data-driven includes keep NAP consistent. The remaining variants come from hand-written prose, one AI-written post, and a policy doc that predates the current footer.
findings.proposed_fix: Keep the current NAP implementation. The owner confirms the canonical public name string used on the Google Business Profile and the site; do not change display_name unilaterally. Fix the BLG-01632 sentence only via revise-published.py with --approval-ref. The owner decides whether docs/NAP-CONTACT-POLICY.md is retired or updated to match the implemented footer. Re-run nap_scan.py after template changes.
findings.rollback: Not applicable (no change proposed beyond the owner-approved revise batch, which has its own rollback).
findings.benefit: Prevents unnecessary NAP churn and records the evidence so future waves do not re-audit it.

findings.title: Unverified rental policies on 9 static/commercial pages are not in data/business-facts.json (helmet, insurance, age 18+, minimum 1 day, 24-hour day, payment methods); one contradicts the main site
findings.evidence:
FACT (grep over static .md; none of these terms is in data/business-facts.json):
- 'Mũ bảo hiểm đi kèm xe khi nhận' (helmet included): bang-gia.md, bang-gia-xe-50cc.md:67, bang-gia-xe-so.md:97, kinh-nghiem.md:86. reports/factory/policy-conflicts.md marks a helmet claim as BLOCKED ('cấm khẳng định kèm mũ bảo hiểm').
- 'Nguyễn Tú không cung cấp bảo hiểm' (no insurance provided): bang-gia.md, gioi-thieu.md, lien-he.md, dieu-khoan.md, blog.md:119. Insurance is also marked BLOCKED (one-sided source C).
- 'đủ 18 tuổi' (age 18+): bang-gia.md, bang-gia-xe-50cc.md, dieu-khoan.md, kinh-nghiem.md, lien-he.md.
- 'Thời gian thuê tối thiểu là 1 ngày' (minimum 1 day): bang-gia.md, gioi-thieu.md, lien-he.md.
- 'tính cho một chu kỳ 24 giờ kể từ thời điểm nhận xe' (24-hour day from pickup): bang-gia.md:20, gioi-thieu.md:49. This contradicts the main site's live text 'Không mặc định mọi đơn đều tính một ngày bằng 24 giờ'.
- Cash and mobile payment: lien-he.md.
- Fuel, loss and cross-border clauses: dieu-khoan.md.
Also, reports/factory/policy-conflicts.md (which validate.py:102 references and which writers are told to read) still lists the deposit as BLOCKED and shows old prices, although deposits of 2–5M were approved on 27/10.
findings.root_cause: The static pages were written from an older campaign knowledge base (source C) before the rule 'only data/business-facts.json'. The policy-conflicts report was never refreshed after the owner's 27/10 approval.
findings.proposed_fix: The owner confirms each policy (yes or no, plus the exact wording). Confirmed items go into data/business-facts.json and _data/business.yml, for example a `policies:` block, and the pages reference them. Unconfirmed items get a SAFE_PAGE_CONTENT reword to the 'xác nhận trước khi đặt xe' form allowed by policy-conflicts.md, for example 'Hỏi Nguyễn Tú về mũ bảo hiểm đi kèm khi đặt xe'. Align the 24-hour statement with the owner's actual rule and with the main site. A maintainer/owner PR refreshes reports/factory/policy-conflicts.md (deposit resolved; price list pointing to pricing.yml). Nothing is invented. Listed last per the AGENTS.md rule on unverified policy information.
findings.rollback: git revert of the page edits; the business-facts additions are reverted by the owner.
findings.benefit: Commercial pages state only owner-verified terms, which removes contradictions with the main site and the risk of customer disputes, and writer guidance stops pointing to a stale conflicts file.
findings.next: Chờ chủ website quyết định (xem báo cáo wave4)

verdicts.corrected_measurement: FACT: the auditor's numbers are right, but they leave out the part that matters. I re-measured on site-base at HEAD a7aaedf with my own scripts (/tmp/claude-0/-home-user-blog/c0138ac4-51ee-5beb-a1c9-21d2311d0295/scratchpad/audit/review-SD-03/measure.py and m2.py). 6,257 of 7,050 HTML pages carry BlogPosting, which matches the 6,257 files in _posts. On all 6,257, BlogPosting.image is https://blog.thuexemaynguyentu.com/IMG_2536.jpeg. That file is a 512x512 JPEG (PIL), and visual inspection shows it is the brand logo with the text 'Thuê Xe Máy Hà Nội / Nguyễn Tú'. _posts has 0 image/cover/thumbnail/og_image keys, 0 markdown images and 0 , and article.post-detail contains 0 in the build. Missing from the finding: on the same 6,257 pages, og:image is the logo (6,257/6,257), twitter:image is the logo (6,257/6,257), and the only on every post page is that same /IMG_2536.jpeg, shown at 44, 40 and 48 px. The logo is the only image anywhere on these pages, in any form.
verdicts.reasons: (a) The issue is real. The logo is used as BlogPosting.image on all 6,257 posts (FACT, re-measured). The Google Article doc (last updated 2026-09-08, https://developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/structured-data/article) says: 'Use images that are relevant to the article, rather than logos or captions… Images must represent the marked up content'. It also says Article has no required properties, so leaving image out is valid. (b) The fix gives no real benefit and overstates what it achieves. - Google's Image SEO doc (https://developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/google-images#specify-a-preferred-image), section 'Specify a preferred image with metadata', treats schema.org image/primaryImageOfPage AND the og:image meta tag as equal signals for the preferred image. It says to avoid a generic image such as the site logo 'in the schema.org markup or og:image meta tag'. - The proposed fix removes only the schema signal. og:image and twitter:image stay as the logo, and the logo is the only on every post page (6,257/6,257). - So Google's image choice for these pages cannot change: there is no other image to pick. The claim 'Stops declaring a logo as the representative image … as Google's image guidelines require' is therefore wrong; og:image still declares it. - Users see no change, and I expect no measurable effect on SERP, Discover or CTR (INFERRED). The 512 px square is below the 1200 px width Discover needs for large cards anyway. - Probable side effect (INFERRED, not verified with the Rich Results Test): the Article doc says the Rich Results Test skips the warning only for datePublished/dateModified. Removing image would most likely add a non-critical 'Missing field "image"' warning on all 6,257 posts, trading a guideline mismatch no tool reports for a warning tools do show, with no gain. This is cosmetic markup hygiene, not a P2 problem. It is at most P3. (c) The change itself would be safe. Nothing in scripts/ or .github asserts BlogPosting or its image (grep for BlogPosting, ld_logo, IMG_2536 and "image" found nothing). check-built-links.py:115 only checks og:image, which the fix leaves alone. faq_parity_check only needs JSON-LD to parse, and removing the line inside the {% if %} keeps the JSON valid. The QA content_sha256 hashes the _posts source files (validate.py:411), not the rendered HTML. The change touches no URLs, canonicals, business data (business.logo itself is unchanged) or frozen homepage strings, since the homepage is not layout: post. It does not conflict with SEO-106 (DECIDED_KEEP), which covers Organization/LocalBusiness only, and it is not in do_not. The claim "candidate fix gives 0 nodes / removes the only AA failures" is wrong. The auditor counted only axe violations and ignored axe "incomplete" (shortTextContent) results, which are real failures. With the proposed CSS injected, these still fail:
- (1) Current page in pagination, span.page-link[aria-current=page]: #fff on #4d99ff = 2.87:1 in dark, on 770 paginated pages.
- (2) Selected .day-btn in the rental calculator on / and /bang-gia/ at mobile width. It is #202020 on #0066cc = 2.92:1 in LIGHT mode and #e0e0e0 on #4d99ff = 2.17:1 in dark. Root cause: responsive.css lines 339 and 524 use var(--color-primary-contrast), but no stylesheet defines that token, so the text inherits the body colour.
- (3) The mobile .phone-launcher__toggle icon, on all 7,047 pages, has the same undefined token. Its stroke is #202020 on #0066cc (2.92:1) in light and #e0e0e0 on #4d99ff (2.17:1) in dark, below the 3:1 non-text contrast minimum (WCAG 1.4.11).
- (4) .assistant-toggle__label, on all 7,047 pages: white 16px semibold on a #4d99ff to #3377cc gradient in dark, 2.87 to 4.51:1. axe can only report this as bgGradient incomplete.

With my corrected change set (below), loaded into the real stylesheets through request interception, all 48 runs gave 0 violations and 0 shortTextContent incompletes. verdicts.reasons:
(a) The problem is real. Every colour pair the auditor reported reproduces to two decimals. Dark mode is real-world traffic, not a toggle few people use: _layouts/default.html lines 23-37 set data-theme="dark" automatically from prefers-color-scheme when nothing is saved. The measurement is still incomplete. It missed the pagination current page in dark (770 pages), and the undefined --color-primary-contrast token. That bug breaks the selected day button on the commercial pages / and /bang-gia/ in LIGHT mode as well, and the mobile phone-launcher icon on every page in both themes. It also missed the dark-mode assistant-toggle gradient. So "removes the only WCAG AA contrast failures" is false.

(b) The fix helps users, not rankings. It is more than cosmetic: it makes in-article links readable in dark mode on 6,257 pages, and it makes the primary CTA "Gọi 0942 467 674" and the pagination legible. WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.3 and 1.4.11, web.dev "Color and contrast accessibility" and the Lighthouse color-contrast audit all call for it. It is not a Google ranking signal: contrast is not among the page-experience signals at https://developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/page-experience. Report it as an accessibility/UX/conversion fix, not as SEO. P2 is appropriate.

(c) The change is safe. It edits CSS only and touches no _posts bytes, URLs, canonicals, business data or frozen homepage strings. No test, checker or workflow asserts CSS values: I grepped scripts/, .github/workflows, check-regressions.py and frozen-homepage.json. The only interaction is test_gate_scope.py, which classifies assets/css/* as gate mode "full", the expected path. The change is not in checkpoint "do_not", and no DECIDED_KEEP or other item covers contrast. The inline styles in 404.html and tim-kiem.html only use --color-primary as text colour, which is unchanged. The muted token's other uses are breadcrumb separators, chevrons, the assistant placeholder and disclosure, mobile-hours-note, the empty topic count and the status dot. All get lighter in dark and darker in light; .calculator-disclaimer is unaffected because base.css `p {color:var(--color-text)}` overrides it.

- (1) Cover the missed components.
- (2) Use tokens instead of hard-coded dark-only selector overrides. A selector-level `[data-theme=dark] .day-btn.selected` override written outside the max-width:767px media query is wrong. I measured that it paints the desktop selected button blue with #e0e0e0 text at 3.77:1, a new failure.

(c) The proposal needs one change.
- The proposed Tab focus trap should NOT be added. web.dev defines a modal as one where 'the rest of the page is inert', usually behind a backdrop. This widget has no backdrop, no scroll lock and no inert background, and mouse users can click the page while it is open.
- A keyboard-only trap on top of a mouse-interactive page creates a half-modal. Making it fully modal (inert main/header/footer plus backdrop) is a larger UX decision.
- The correct low-risk path matches the visual design: a non-modal dialog. Remove aria-modal="true", keep role=dialog plus aria-labelledby, return focus to the toggle on close, and fix the name. Also add aria-expanded="false" to the markup.

- Pressing Escape after tabbing into the background does not take focus away from where the user is.

- Opening the mobile menu over the assistant and pressing Escape still returns focus to the mobile-menu toggle, both before and after the patch.

The problem is real, but the auditor overcounted it: 5 files carry GPS, not 6, and IMG_2536 has no GPS at all. All 5 GPS files share one GPS stamp, which cannot be a real per-photo capture. **Benefit**
- I verified the guidance directly. Gary Illyes in the Jan 2023 office hours (https://developers.google.com/search/help/office-hours/2023/january): "Google doesn't use EXIF data for anything at the moment. The only image data, or metadata, that we currently use is IPTC."

It asks only that IPTC creator / credit line / copyright notice be kept when possible. None of these files has any of those fields (checked: xe-50cc's IPTC/XMP holds only dates; IMG_2536's IPTC is empty), so no attribution is lost.

Wave, Vision, 50cc and xe-dap-dien are 1200x800 each. xe-may-dien is 1600x900. verdicts.reasons:
(a) The issue is real and correctly counted, re-measured independently (see corrected_measurement). The site-wide og:image is a 512px square logo with text, and with summary_large_image it is cropped on X/Twitter. (b) Current guidance supports the change. Google's "Specify a preferred image with metadata" section (https://developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/google-images#specify-preferred-image, fetched today) says og:image or primaryImageOfPage can influence the text-result image. It also says: "Choose an image that's relevant and representative of the page. Avoid using a generic image (for example, your site logo) or an image with text … Use a high resolution, if possible." The benefit is real but modest, about P2/P3, and limited to 11 commercial pages: - a possible thumbnail in text results (CTR effect INFERRED, since no GSC data exists for the blog); - a proper social share card; - a visible vehicle photo on the price and hub pages, which helps users. The Discover benefit should be removed from the claim. Discover large previews need max-image-preview:large, which no page sets (FACT), and hubs are not Discover content. (c) Technically safe, checked against the repo: - No _posts bytes, URLs, canonicals or JSON-LD change. - The homepage is untouched: it uses layout home, page.url '/' is not mapped, and H1 in check-regressions only compares h1, title, meta description, hero and canonical. - check-regressions H2 (one h1) holds, because the figure adds no h1. - H5 (intro words between and the first

) only increases, because the figcaption adds words. - H8 (no bare & in og tags) holds: the alts contain no '&', and they will be escaped anyway. - check-built-links resolves og:image and twitter:image to local files, and the assets/images/services/*.jpeg files exist in _site. - test_faq.py:357 asserts the faq include line in page.html; keep that line intact. - No test or workflow asserts the logo og:image or a 512 width (grep of scripts/ and .github/workflows found only check-built-links collecting og:image). - The quality-gate canonical, legacy-host and hub-sanity steps are unaffected. - The data-key access pattern is already proven in this repo: site.data.seo-leads[...] in topic.html, and business.vehicle_types | where: "name", x | first in home.html:146. - SEO-106 is DECIDED_KEEP (Organization/LocalBusiness schema): the change must not touch the LocalBusiness or Organization image/logo in JSON-LD. - None of the checkpoint do_not items apply. What keeps this from a plain IMPLEMENT: 1. The photos appear to be manufacturer or third-party images with UNKNOWN rights. Making them og:image spreads them further (social platforms cache them, and Google Images indexes them on 11 more URLs). They also show specific branded models (SYM Elite 50, Yadea Osta, Hitasa) that business-facts does not confirm, and content_rules says electric vehicles are "xác nhận theo mẫu xe" (to be confirmed per model). The owner must confirm the rights and that the photos are representative before merge. The image choice is NEEDS_OWNER; only the mechanism is SAFE_TEMPLATE. The images are already owner-curated business data in _data/business.yml and live on the homepage, so the extra risk is incremental, not new. 2. The proposed Liquid assumes pv is shared between seo.html and the layouts. It is not: topic.html/page.html and default.html, which includes seo.html, are rendered as separate Liquid renders. Each place must resolve the image itself.
